# `_kit/` — generated by `kit-init.sh`

## Layout convention (one approach, used for every surface)
Every surface folder (`agentforce/`, `lightning/`, `tableau/`, `tableau-next/`, `data360/`, `slack/`) is laid
out the same way, so the rule is the same everywhere:

```
<surface>/
  chrome/<shell-name>/...   one subfolder per shell this surface needs, copied verbatim
                            from the kit (css, html partials, fonts/, assets/)
  tokens/<name>.css         any shared token file(s) this surface's shell(s) link directly
  <beatId>-<type>.html      the starting page for each beat on this surface, copied from the
                            kit's shell demo and with every relative href/src REWRITTEN to
                            point at the chrome/ and tokens/ paths above
  _gate/<beatId>/           fidelity-gate.sh output, once you run it
```

This mirrors the kit's own internal nesting (`chrome/<shell>/`, `tokens/`) one level under each
surface folder, instead of flattening a shell's files into the surface root. Picking one
convention and using it everywhere means the fix is always the same shape: a page's old
`../lex-shell/...` becomes `chrome/lex-shell/...`, and an old `../../tokens/...` becomes
`tokens/...`. Dry run #2's friction (broken `../lex-shell/` paths, 404s on CSS/fonts/icons after a
builder copied a page by hand) was builders rewriting these ad hoc, differently each time, with no
written rule — `kit-init.sh` does the rewrite once, consistently, so no builder has to again.

Fonts (`chrome/lex-shell/fonts/`, `chrome/slack-shell/assets/fonts/`), icons/avatars (`chrome/*/assets/`) and
tokens (`tokens/`) are copied for you; `_kit/avatars/` holds the shared persona pool.

Never hand-edit a copied `chrome/<shell>/` file to fix a path problem — if a path is wrong, fix the
rewrite rule in `kit-init.sh` (or re-run it) rather than patching the copy, so every beat on that
surface stays identical to the kit.

## Files here
- `manifest.tsv` — one row per beat: `beatId  screenType  folder  gateSurface  pageRelPath`. The
  single source of truth that `gate-all.sh` and `404-check.py` both read.
- `avatars/` — the shared persona-photo pool (see `../PERSONAS.md`). Referenced from each surface
  folder as `../_kit/avatars/<file>`.
- `404-check.py` — loads every beat's starter page headless over `file://` and fails on any failed
  request, then statically checks that every local `<a href>`/`src`/`href` target exists (a dead
  link to another page never issues a request, so the headless load alone misses it). Re-run it any time after editing a page: `python3 _kit/404-check.py`.
- `critics-workflow.js` is the calibrated blind critic pair. Run it with
  `Workflow({scriptPath: "<project>/_kit/critics-workflow.js", args: [...]})`. Each page's
  `_gate/<beat>/<page>/CRITIC-BRIEF.md` prints ready-to-paste `args`. The project gets a copy because the
  Workflow tool only accepts a script path inside the working directory.

## Never
- Never edit anything under `~/.claude/skills/keynote-prototype/` from inside this project. If a
  shell itself needs a fix, write it to `FRICTION-<surface>.md` in the project root instead.
- Never retype a shell page from scratch. `cp` the starting page this tool already made, then make
  targeted edits — a from-scratch retype is what hits the 16K output cap mid-page.
